summary: Validated L1 execution benchmark reconciled to revision 5: a causal queue-aware maker/taker gate reduced five-second execution drag by 0.200 bp in development, 0.199 bp in validation and 0.149 bp in confirmation, but standalone net expectancy remained about -11.8 bp. Retain as the execution-routing component leader for prospective Shadow only; the strategy Champion is unchanged.

Hard-valid official Binance USD-M four-asset dynamic-factor residual study. Candidate 021fbab613517a31ad98 produced 194 one-global-slot trades and actual-funding returns +23.2585%/+16.7170%/+11.2649% at 12/18/24bp, geometric daily growth +0.0573077%, PF 1.5041 and MDD 4.6174%. It is provisional rank 1 by target proximity but fails the registered economic gate: top-10%-removed return -21.8583%, median trade negative and all four frozen 2024 portfolios lost.

Hard-valid BTCUSDT/ETHUSDT/SOLUSDT/XRPUSDT one-global-slot study with historical funding. The 216-policy five-minute screen and 324-policy prior-volume dollar-clock follow-up produced zero preregistered development survivors and opened no sequential OOS. Exploratory aligned-continuation 33034b092ffd271a recorded 0.0227977% geometric daily growth near 15bp and 0.0118956% near 30bp, 184/183 trades, PF 1.306/1.160 and MDD 6.47%/7.84%, but failed yearly robustness and the 2x top-five-removal gate. It is provisional rank 2 only.

Recovered the immutable ten-day BTC cross-venue liquidation/depth artifact and re-evaluated 7,760 original continuation, reclaim and venue-transfer policies plus 680 low-dimensional mechanism policies under chronological confirmation, next-observed bid/ask execution, one global slot, 8-24 bp costs and top-trade-removal gates. Zero strict or exploratory survivors were found. The tested historical specification is retained as valid negative evidence and does not change the strategy first place or live permission.

Implemented an observation-only Binance/Bybit public and Bybit private forward evidence layer with local wall and monotonic receive clocks, raw-payload hashes, append-only record chains, environment-only authentication, execId-authoritative reconciliation, exact-capture-prefix Shadow A/B and automatic risk-state mapping. The readable source passed 22 local tests, per-file manifest verification and compileall. No prospective observations exist yet; no alpha, Paper/Live promotion or order-placement capability is claimed.
